en.headline: Heath opens a public-regret show in Chungking Mansions
en.dek: What We Regret Most, built from about 40 public submissions, runs in Tsim Sha Tsui until 27 October.
body: A show built from strangers’ regrets opened on Thursday night at Heath, in the basement of Chungking Mansions, and runs until 27 October.

The exhibition, titled What We Regret Most, brings together about 40 objects and stories submitted by members of the public, according to the venue listing. Heath, at 36-44 Nathan Road in Tsim Sha Tsui, is hosting the show. Honmi Studio designed it. An opening gathering was held at 6pm on Thursday.
A closing ceremony involving the artist and researcher Sonia Wong is listed for 27 October. The listing did not give daily opening hours or an admission price.

zh.headline: 重慶大廈Heath展出公眾「最後悔」故事
zh.dek: 展覽《What We Regret Most》周四晚開幕，展至10月27日，約有40件公眾投稿。
body: 尖沙咀重慶大廈地庫藝術空間Heath周四晚開幕一個以後悔為題的展覽，展期至10月27日。
場地資料顯示，展覽名為What We Regret Most，集合約40件由公眾提交的物件和故事。空間位於彌敦道36至44號重慶大廈地庫，由Honmi Studio設計。開幕聚會於周四下午6時舉行。
資料列明10月27日有藝術家兼研究者 Sonia Wong 的閉幕環節，但未有公布每日開放時間和入場收費。
